newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 17.

text.p: These were the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Six media organisations file petition in the Supreme Court challenging the Broadcasting Authority bill recently presented in parliament.
Parliament Select Committee to finalise section on devolution within next five weeks so that the draft constitution can be presented to parliament before the budget, informed sources say.
Political parties get ready for May Day celebrations, which usually occasion for show of strength.
Trials during recent Maha cultivation season show average yield from an acre of paddy can be raised to 120 bushels from current 80, a top agricultural ministry official says.
